sources.entry: Spotify4BigSur - Spotify widget for Notification Center.

summary.one_liner: A Spotify widget for the macOS Notification Center that controls Spotify through its AppleScript API.
summary.what_it_does: Adds a Spotify widget to the macOS Notification Center, built with WidgetKit. The README says it reads track information from Spotify and controls playback using Spotify's AppleScript API. It is a fork of Spotify4Me by Carabineiro, reworked to run on newer macOS. The README says it targets macOS 11.0 Big Sur and mentions compatibility with macOS 10.11 Notification Center. Installation is by copying the SpotifyMain.app from the latest release into Applications and launching it, then adding the widget from Notification Center. Upgrading means restarting the Mac, replacing the old app, and starting the new one.
use_cases: control Spotify playback from Notification Center
see the currently playing track on macOS
play, pause, or skip songs without opening Spotify
replace an older Spotify4Me widget on macOS Big Sur
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the repository's releases page
Copy SpotifyMain.app to your Applications folder
Open Notification Center and add the Spotify widget
To upgrade: restart the Mac, replace the old SpotifyMain.app with the new one, and start it
notable: Uses Spotify's AppleScript API for track info and playback control
Fork of Spotify4Me reworked with WidgetKit
Targets the macOS Notification Center widget area
caveats: Requires macOS with Notification Center widgets; README names macOS 11.0 Big Sur and macOS 10.11 compatibility
Relies on Spotify's AppleScript API, which may limit what it can show or control
README does not describe build steps, tests, or ongoing maintenance status
